### call 1: node=spark-1 timeout=15 check=True
set -u
container=cluster-vllm-1
marker_root=${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/dgx-controller
owner=$(cat "$marker_root/dep-cluster-profile.owner" 2>/dev/null || true)
if [ ! -e "$marker_root/dep-cluster-profile.owner" ]; then
  legacy_root=${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}/dgx-controller
  owner=$(cat "$legacy_root/dep-cluster-profile.owner" 2>/dev/null || true)
fi
launcher_active=inactive
launcher_sub=dead
launcher_result=
if [ 1 = 1 ]; then
  launcher_active=$(systemctl --user show dgx-cluster-dep-cluster-profile.service     -p ActiveState --value 2>/dev/null || printf inactive)
  launcher_sub=$(systemctl --user show dgx-cluster-dep-cluster-profile.service     -p SubState --value 2>/dev/null || printf dead)
  launcher_result=$(systemctl --user show dgx-cluster-dep-cluster-profile.service     -p Result --value 2>/dev/null || true)
fi
if ! docker inspect "$container" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  printf '%s
' 'CONTAINER_PRESENT=0' "OWNER=$owner"     "LAUNCHER_ACTIVE=$launcher_active" "LAUNCHER_SUB=$launcher_sub"     "LAUNCHER_RESULT=$launcher_result"
  exit 0
fi
running=$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$container" 2>/dev/null   || printf false)
container_status=$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Status}}' "$container"   2>/dev/null || true)
container_exit_code=$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.ExitCode}}' "$container"   2>/dev/null || true)
echo "CONTAINER_STATUS=$container_status"
echo "CONTAINER_EXIT_CODE=$container_exit_code"
image=$(docker inspect -f '{{.Config.Image}}' "$container" 2>/dev/null || true)
image_id=$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$container" 2>/dev/null || true)
cmd=$(docker inspect -f '{{json .Config.Cmd}}' "$container" 2>/dev/null   | base64 -w0 || true)
container_env=$(docker inspect -f '{{json .Config.Env}}' "$container"   2>/dev/null | base64 -w0 || true)
health=000
models=
if [ 1 = 1 ]; then
  health=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 3     http://127.0.0.1:8888/health 2>/dev/null || true)
  models=$(curl -fsS --max-time 3 http://127.0.0.1:8888/v1/models 2>/dev/null || true)
fi
printf '%s
' 'CONTAINER_PRESENT=1' "RUNNING=$running" "IMAGE=$image"   "IMAGE_ID=$image_id" "CMD_B64=$cmd" "OWNER=$owner" "HEALTH_CODE=$health"   "ENV_B64=$container_env"   "LAUNCHER_ACTIVE=$launcher_active" "LAUNCHER_SUB=$launcher_sub"   "LAUNCHER_RESULT=$launcher_result"   "MODELS_B64=$(printf '%s' "$models" | base64 -w0)"   "MEM_AVAILABLE=$(awk '/^MemAvailable:/ {print $2 * 1024}' /proc/meminfo)"   "SWAP_USED=$(awk '/^SwapTotal:/ {total=$2}     /^SwapFree:/ {print (total-$2) * 1024}' /proc/meminfo)"
### call 2: node=spark-2 timeout=15 check=True
set -u
container=cluster-vllm-1

echo "CONTAINER_STATUS=$container_status"
echo "CONTAINER_EXIT_CODE=$container_exit_code"

fi

' 'CONTAINER_PRESENT=1' "RUNNING=$running" "IMAGE=$image"   "IMAGE_ID=$image_id" "CMD_B64=$cmd" "OWNER=$owner" "HEALTH_CODE=$health"   "ENV_B64=$container_env"   "LAUNCHER_ACTIVE=$launcher_active" "LAUNCHER_SUB=$launcher_sub"   "LAUNCHER_RESULT=$launcher_result"   "MODELS_B64=$(printf '%s' "$models" | base64 -w0)"   "MEM_AVAILABLE=$(awk '/^MemAvailable:/ {print $2 * 1024}' /proc/meminfo)"   "SWAP_USED=$(awk '/^SwapTotal:/ {total=$2}     /^SwapFree:/ {print (total-$2) * 1024}' /proc/meminfo)"
### call 3: node=spark-1 timeout=120 check=False
set -u
unit=dgx-cluster-dep-cluster-profile.service
systemctl --user stop "$unit" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
systemctl --user reset-failed "$unit" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
### call 4: node=spark-1 timeout=150 check=False
set -eu
script_path=/recipes/stop.sh
expected_hash=bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
test -r "$script_path"
bash -n "$script_path"
test "$(sha256sum "$script_path" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$expected_hash"
test -r /recipes/.env.dgx-controller-cluster-profile
cd /recipes
ENV_FILE=/recipes/.env.dgx-controller-cluster-profile /bin/bash "$script_path"
### call 5: node=spark-1 timeout=15 check=False
set -u
root=${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/dgx-controller
test ! -f "$root/dep-cluster-profile.owner" || unlink "$root/dep-cluster-profile.owner"
legacy_root=${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}/dgx-controller
test ! -f "$legacy_root/dep-cluster-profile.owner" \
  || unlink "$legacy_root/dep-cluster-profile.owner"
### call 6: node=spark-2 timeout=15 check=False
set -u
root=${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/dgx-controller
test ! -f "$root/dep-cluster-profile.owner" || unlink "$root/dep-cluster-profile.owner"
legacy_root=${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}/dgx-controller
test ! -f "$legacy_root/dep-cluster-profile.owner" \
  || unlink "$legacy_root/dep-cluster-profile.owner"
